samba

n. 桑巴舞（巴西交谊舞）
v. 跳桑巴舞
例句：Yet, this is also the land of samba and world-class soccer, a country built by European immigrants and African slaves.

如果当时巴西留意之外的南美，都是足球、桑巴和高通胀。
